name: preset_redline
first_used: kit/hf/demos/redline (2026-10-19, stills only; not yet on a real film)
reference: the owner's github/reverse-engineer thumbnail (2026-10-19): graph paper, heavy black grotesk, one red marker underline, pencil sketches, his face peeking from the bottom

palette.highlighter: #FFE45C (screens only, never in a frame that has red; optional)

type.display: Schibsted Grotesk 900 (800 for word-on-voice lines), tracking -0.03em, leading 0.95
type.labels: Martian Mono 500, mixed case ('Fig. 2 — Gemini, day 1'), 21 px (26 px in 9:16): figure captions, sources, the section marker (first ~8 s of a section only)
type.hand: Nanum Pen Script (red margin notes), 66-80 px

sizes.evidence_min: 28 px at 1080p long-form, 40 px on a Reel (after every zoom)

pen.budget: one mark per sentence, three on screen at most, only on claim words
pen.engine: perfect-freehand: size 12, thinning .18, smoothing .6, streamline .45, pressure .75->1->.85, tapers 0.6x / 2.4x size; centreline noise 1.1 px @ 220 px + 0.35 px @ 28 px; speed v ~ R^(1/3) x minimum jerk

pencil.icons: kit/hf/redline.js ICONS (webcam, mic, window, monitor, phone, chat, terminal, cursor, file, globe, person, signal, clock, git, db, bolt, list, spark)

tiers: evidence: full bleed, marks on the tracing sheet (window: frost the rest)
figure: 66-75 % wide, 2 px ink outline, FIG. NN caption
taped print: stills only, +-1.5 deg, two tape strips

zoom.reel: crop to one panel, text >= 40 px
zoom.hold: 0.8 s + words / 3 per second, at least 2.5 s

screens.redaction: a solid bar in the UI's colour (pixelation and blur can be reversed)

face.room: his real room, graded only (no cut-out, no background effects by default: claude-makes-claude ledger)
face.window: square corners, 2 px ink outline, optional mono label under it
face.change: a hard cut; a 0.28 s slide only when the layout continues
face.peek: opt-in: the cut-out rising from the bottom edge, for title cards and the hook
face.reel_safe: face boxes end by y 1560; eyes at y 1380-1480 at the lowest; faceY 0.38; the peek rises over an ink rule at y 1560

reel.captions: always, paper label, max 5 words, no recolour

audio.sfx: physical events only: a real marker stroke, a paper sheet; none on cuts; never canned crowd

qa.holds: pages, cards, sheets and look() are declared reading holds

sketches: 2-3 objects the video actually uses, asymmetric; reuse arrows/brackets later
